title: Polyp removal during colonoscopy
what: A polyp is a small growth on the bowel wall. During a colonoscopy, the doctor removes it with a wire loop or tiny forceps through the same tube.
why: If a polyp is found during a colonoscopy. Some polyps can turn into cancer over time, so they are removed early.
duration: usually adds 5 to 20 minutes to the colonoscopy; polyp test results usually come in 1 to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: Blood thinners. They are sometimes changed before removal. Your doctor decides
If polyps were removed before. Bring the reports

prepare.title: Same as for a colonoscopy
prepare.text: A low-fiber diet for 2 to 3 days and bowel prep solution as your doctor says.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor about all your medicines. They will decide what to change and when.

prepare.title: Sedation
prepare.text: If you will be asleep, you need someone to take you home.

bring: Someone to take you home, if you have sedation
steps: The doctor finds the polyp and examines it
A thin wire loop or forceps is passed through the tube
The polyp is cut from the wall, and sometimes the spot is sealed with heat
Sometimes a tiny clip is placed on the spot
The polyp is taken out and sent for testing
feel: You usually do not feel the removal. The bowel wall has no pain nerves
Bloating from the air, as after any colonoscopy
after: Usually light food and no alcohol for 1 to 2 days. Ask your doctor
For a few days, no heavy lifting or intense sports, if your doctor says so
A little blood in your stool in the first days can happen
The clip comes out by itself. You do not need to look for it
Your doctor will set your next colonoscopy based on the test result
red_flags: Heavy bleeding from the bottom or clots: call emergency services
Severe belly pain that keeps getting worse: call emergency services
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), weakness, or dizziness: see a doctor right away

faq.a: Most often not. The test will show what it was. Removal is done to stop the polyp from changing.
New polyps can appear. That is why your doctor sets a follow-up colonoscopy after a certain time.

reminders.text: Colonoscopy with polyp removal tomorrow. Today, clear liquids only, and the prep solution as your doctor said.
